name: L01 Tool call — language_detection on an English opener (cancellation notice)
simulation_scenario_comment: The agent has just greeted in French. The caller answers in English. The LLM must call the language_detection system tool before answering, because the caller's language is not the language the agent is speaking.

chat_history.message: Bonjour, service à la clientèle de Groupe Auto Laval, ici Léa. Comment puis-je vous aider? … For English, just say so.
If I can't make it, how much notice do you need?
